description: This file defines an OpenTelemetry metrics provider class for a server application, including setup of metrics, exporters, and middleware for HTTP request metrics.

classes.name: OpenTelemetry
classes.description: Implements IMetricsProvider to collect and export metrics using OpenTelemetry, including HTTP request metrics and version info.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the metrics provider, 'OpenTelemetry'.

methods.name: initializeCounters
methods.description: Initializes metrics, exporters, and middleware for collecting metrics.

methods.name: recordHttpRequestDuration
methods.description: Records the duration of an HTTP request.

methods.name: recordHttpRequest
methods.description: Increments the HTTP request counter with labels.

methods.name: setupMetricsEndpoint
methods.description: Sets up middleware for tracking request metrics and handles graceful shutdown.

methods.name: incrementCounter
methods.description: Increments a specified counter with provided payload.
